name: A study for a portrait of Alexander Grant and his family
summary: A study for a group portrait of Captain Alexander Grant, his wife and three children, resident in Macau. In the early 1830s Grant was Captain of the opium receiving ship 'Hercules', based at Lintin Island; he was a close associate of the leading merchants William Jardine and James Matheson.
